description: This file contains a Java class 'RenderContentAndSubContent' implementing a FreeMarker TemplateTransformModel. It provides functionality to render content and sub-content within a web application, integrating with OFBiz framework components. The main logic involves setting up the environment, handling locale, and rendering content based on content IDs and other parameters.

classes.name: RenderContentAndSubContent
classes.description: A FreeMarker transform class for rendering content and sub-content within OFBiz framework. Implements TemplateTransformModel and manages output rendering with locale and request context.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer instance that handles rendering of sub-content when closed, based on a provided environment map and arguments.

methods.name: renderSubContent
methods.description: Handles the core rendering logic: retrieves content IDs, locale, and invokes ContentWorker methods to generate output.
